# First Tier Painting

> Owner-operated painting contractor based in Worcester, Massachusetts. First Tier Painting handles interior, exterior, cabinet, deck painting and staining, power washing and commercial painting for homes and businesses across Central Massachusetts. Estimates are free and usually sent by text message.

Key facts:

- Phone and text: +1 (407) 305-1727
- Email: Info@firsttierpainting.com
- Based in: Worcester, MA 01607
- Service area: Central Massachusetts (customers confirm by ZIP code)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7 AM to 7 PM
- Instagram: @firsttierpainting
- Preferred contact: text message
- Not offered: wallpaper installation, full drywall hanging
- Seasonality: exterior work runs spring to fall; winter focuses on interiors, cabinets and commercial spaces

## Main page

- [Home](https://first.escolats.com.br/): services, painting process, project photos, reviews, FAQ and the free estimate form

## Services

- [Interior Painting](https://first.escolats.com.br/#services): walls, ceilings and trim with clean, washable paint
- [Exterior Painting](https://first.escolats.com.br/#services): siding, trim and wood boards protected from moisture
- [Cabinet Painting](https://first.escolats.com.br/#services): smooth, grease-resistant finish on wood cabinets
- [Deck Painting and Staining](https://first.escolats.com.br/#services): protection before moisture rots and cracks the wood
- [Power Washing](https://first.escolats.com.br/#services): moss, dirt and mold removed from siding, patios and walks
- [Commercial Painting](https://first.escolats.com.br/#services): offices and stores kept clean and sharp
- Also: doors, stairs, windows, gutters, furniture, spray finishes, post construction cleaning and small prep repairs

## How it works

- [Process](https://first.escolats.com.br/#how): 1. send your details, 2. get your estimate after a visit, 3. enjoy fresh paint on your schedule
- [Free estimate form](https://first.escolats.com.br/#estimate): service, ZIP code, timeline and contact preference
